description: issue #851: `set_shape "turtle"` is ACCEPTED as an argument, not merely present as the default. The other three portable-word fixtures only ever show `"turtle"` as the `from` of a shape-change, which pins the initial state and proves nothing about whether the word may be passed to `set_shape` - an implementation could reject `set_shape "turtle"` and still pass all of them, while violating the MUST that `spec/rendering.md:119` now states. So this fixture moves away first (`"triangle"`) and back, and the second `shape-change` ({from: "triangle", to: "turtle"}) is the acceptance no other fixture records.
